note: Cats by build (docs/animal/PLAN.md §3): the standard build carries the full action list, cobby, large longhair and slender builds four signature actions each. Main view is the side; the build shows through proportion, head, ears and tail, never coat (D-14).

forms.species: domestic cat
forms.desc: sitting upright on its haunches, front legs straight and close together under the chest, hind legs folded flat at the sides with the hind paws forward, tail curled around the front paws, head level and facing forward, ears up
forms.keep: upright sit, straight front legs together, hind legs folded at the sides, tail wrapped around the front paws, head level

forms.species: domestic cat
forms.desc: a full forward stretch: front legs reaching far forward flat on the ground with the chest lowered close to the ground, hind legs straight and the hips raised high, back sloping down from the hips to the shoulders, tail raised straight up, head level between the front legs
forms.keep: forward stretch, front legs flat forward, chest low, hips high on straight hind legs, tail straight up

forms.species: domestic cat

forms.species: domestic cat of standard American Shorthair build: a medium muscular body, a rounded head with medium upright ears, and medium-length legs
forms.desc: standing still on all four paws in a calm square stance: back level, front legs straight and vertical under the shoulders, hind legs set slightly back with the hocks angled backward, tail held low in a gentle curve behind, head level and facing forward, ears up; exactly four paws on the ground

forms.species: domestic cat of standard American Shorthair build: a medium muscular body, a rounded head with medium upright ears, and medium-length legs

forms.species: domestic cat of standard American Shorthair build: a medium muscular body, a rounded head with medium upright ears, and medium-length legs
